format: UTF-8 TSV; tab separator; no index; empty string means missing only where specified

study_accession.description: Public GEO Series or ArrayExpress study accession; study-qualified identity key with sample_identifier.

sample_identifier.description: GEO GSM accession, or exact public ArrayExpress SDRF specimen/sample name. Internal aliases removed; no specimens merged.

harmonized_class.description: Frozen adopted analysis class derived from source annotations and project curation; not a new diagnosis adjudication. Blank for pending-only specimens.

class_assignment_status.description: Whether class was adopted in any frozen cohort; pending-only candidates do not expose provisional labels.

curation_version.description: Version of this manifest; cohort assignments bind the frozen November 2026 analyses.

primary_eligibility_reason.description: Controlled summary of existing eligibility decision; not original clinical text.

primary_minicpg_status.description: Frozen model evaluation disposition. Primary MethyDeep evaluated denotes matched subset; additional scored specimens use scored_not_in_shared_benchmark. Domain evaluated denotes model full subset, which may exceed shared subset.

primary_methydeep_status.description: Frozen model evaluation disposition. Primary MethyDeep evaluated denotes matched subset; additional scored specimens use scored_not_in_shared_benchmark. Domain evaluated denotes model full subset, which may exceed shared subset.

primary_shared_benchmark.description: 1 identifies the exact shared comparison subset; 0 otherwise.

metastatic_methydeep_status.description: Frozen model evaluation disposition. Primary MethyDeep evaluated denotes matched subset; additional scored specimens use scored_not_in_shared_benchmark. Domain evaluated denotes model full subset, which may exceed shared subset.

metastatic_shared_benchmark.description: 1 identifies the exact shared comparison subset; 0 otherwise.

model_status_definitions.evaluated: Member of the specified frozen model analysis subset; see primary MethyDeep qualification.
model_status_definitions.scored_not_in_shared_benchmark: Primary MethyDeep prediction exists but reference class was outside the shared benchmark truth scope.
model_status_definitions.not_cohort_eligible: Not included in this cohort; may belong to another cohort.
model_status_definitions.eligibility_pending: Frozen eligibility unresolved; not evaluated in this cohort.
model_status_definitions.processed_data_unavailable: Eligible primary record lacks adopted processed beta input.
model_status_definitions.probe_coverage_failed: Available primary input fails the model coverage rule.
model_status_definitions.raw_only_processing_not_adopted: Raw-only source; processing was not part of adopted evaluation.
model_status_definitions.source_qc_failed: Frozen source QC excluded this specimen.
model_status_definitions.probe_coverage_or_value_qc_failed: Frozen model extraction failed coverage or value QC; combined source disposition retained.

source_studies_fields.publication_pmid: Semicolon-separated PMIDs present in archived study metadata; blank if absent
source_studies_fields.publication_doi: Semicolon-separated DOIs present in archived study metadata; blank if absent
